request.subject: IMPROVEMENT:FARM

layers.text: Remove all ground: erase the grass and soil slab and the stone path under the farm so the barn, wheat sheaves, haystack and fence stand directly on a transparent background with nothing under them. Make all timber and the door pale straw yellow, never brown. Keep the red roof, cream walls, outline and art style exactly the same.
